config.description: Is the n>8 measurement barrier the scheduler's or the harness's? Paired A/B between the ThreadPoolExecutor launcher every prior experiment used and a barrier-synchronised launcher that pays connection cost before the timed send. Cells hold total tokens far below max_num_batched_tokens so that any splitting cannot be a token-capacity effect.
config.note_cells: seq_len is held at 128 so total tokens stay at 512-4096, i.e. well under max_num_batched_tokens=8192 at every n. If splitting were a token-capacity effect none of these would split; the captured data says n=8 splits about half the time at ~1024 tokens.
config.note_repeats: 15 rather than 9: the quantity is a FRACTION of dispatches that split, and the prior cells sat near 50%, where a 9-sample estimate has a wide interval.
